newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PETZETAKIS SAYS 96 PRFIT UP 41PCT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PETZETAKIS SAYS 96 PRFIT UP 41PCT.

text.p: Plastic pipes manufacturer Petzetakis said its fiscal 1996 pretax profit rose 41 percent to 312 million drachmas on sales growth of 26 percent -- 16.7 billion.
"As regards the parent company, because of the plant's relocation to Thebes, 2.0 billion drachmas worth of orders, mainly exports, were not materialised," the company said.

On a consolidated basis the group's sales rose 14 percent to 25 billion drachmas with pretax profit up 71 percent to 520 million. These results do not include minority interests and the new joint ventures in China and Romania, it said.
Following its 4.0 billion drachma restructuring plan, aimed at raising productivity and containing costs, Petzetakis is upbeat on business prospects this year, it said.
